claim: Every staging release-train gate passes against the deployed Worker endpoints
test:
set -euo pipefail
repo=unbrowse-ai/unbrowse-core
sha=$(gh api "repos/$repo/branches/staging" --jq .commit.sha)
git cat-file -e "$sha^{commit}"
snapshot=$(mktemp -d /tmp/unbrowse-worker-staging-gate.XXXXXX)
printf "Staging %s. Gate snapshot %s\n" "$sha" "$snapshot"
git archive "$sha" .deploy unbrowse-telemetry unbrowse-rpc unbrowse-dashboard unbrowse-ci-shots | tar -x -C "$snapshot"
cd "$snapshot"
node .deploy/deploy.mjs gate staging
test "$(gh api "repos/$repo/branches/staging" --jq .commit.sha)" = "$sha"
